mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those characteristics that cannot be altered by the researcher."
Attribute variables are those characteristics that cannot be altered by the researcher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the validity of the cause and effect inference linking the independent variable and the dependent variable."
Internal validity refers to the validity of the cause and effect inference linking the independent variable and the dependent variable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the relationship between two or paired variables or two or more sets of data."
Correlation is the relationship between two or paired variables or two or more sets of data.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are described here, the first based on the goal or purpose of the research; second is the qualitative - quantitative dichotomy that represents two distinct orientations to phenomenon being studied."

Three systems are described here, the first based on the goal or purpose of the research; second is the qualitative - quantitative dichotomy that represents two distinct orientations to phenomenon being studied.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only threat that is not controlled due to its nature because people die, move away, get disinterested etc."
Attrition is the only threat that is not controlled due to its nature because people die, move away, get disinterested etc.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used here as defined by Campbell and Stanley (1963) and Cook and Campbell (1979), and is said to be of four types: internal, external, construct and statistical conclusion."
Experimental validity is used here as defined by Campbell and Stanley (1963) and Cook and Campbell (1979), and is said to be of four types: internal, external, construct and statistical conclusion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the temporal period during which a unit would have to possess the appropriate characteristics in order to qualify for the sample."
The time factor refers to the temporal period during which a unit would have to possess the appropriate characteristics in order to qualify for the sample.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a clear statement of a problem and sub-problem, the data and how these will be processed and more important of all, how the data will be interpreted."
A research proposal is a clear statement of a problem and sub-problem, the data and how these will be processed and more important of all, how the data will be interpreted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best method of providing for their equivalence."
Assigning individuals by random assignment is the best method of providing for their equivalence.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the conditions or characteristics that the experimenter manipulates or controls in his or her attempt to ascertain their relationship to observed phenomena."
The independent variables are the conditions or characteristics that the experimenter manipulates or controls in his or her attempt to ascertain their relationship to observed phenomena.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conjecture or a guess at the solution to a problem or the status of the situation."
A hypothesis is a conjecture or a guess at the solution to a problem or the status of the situation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that at least theoretically can take an infinite array of values."
Continuous variables are those that at least theoretically can take an infinite array of values.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to determine the influence of variable on one group and not on another."
The static group comparison is used to determine the influence of variable on one group and not on another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process of breaking down, examining, comparing, conceptualising and categorizing data."
Open coding refers to the process of breaking down, examining, comparing, conceptualising and categorizing data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a straightforward document that sets forth clearly and precisely what a researcher has done to resolve a research problem."
A research report is a straightforward document that sets forth clearly and precisely what a researcher has done to resolve a research problem.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means and variances of nominal scaled data such as ethnicity."
A researcher reports means and variances of nominal scaled data such as ethnicity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those aspects of a study or sample that might influence the dependent variables (outcome measure) and whose effects may be confused with the effect of the independent variable."

Confounding variables are those aspects of a study or sample that might influence the dependent variables (outcome measure) and whose effects may be confused with the effect of the independent variable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the reports of a person who relates the testimony of an actual witness of participant in an event."
Secondary sources are the reports of a person who relates the testimony of an actual witness of participant in an event.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the conditions or characteristics that the experimenter manipulates, controls or observes."
Variables are the conditions or characteristics that the experimenter manipulates, controls or observes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a summary of the study that allows the reader to learn enough to decide whether to read the whole thing."
An abstract is a summary of the study that allows the reader to learn enough to decide whether to read the whole thing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the presumed cause of the dependent variable i.e. the presumed effect."
An independent variable is the presumed cause of the dependent variable i.e. the presumed effect.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a creative process that depends in part on the insight of the investigator."
Developing hypotheses from theories is a creative process that depends in part on the insight of the investigator.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used, interviewing involve much more than just asking questions."
Regardless of which form is used, interviewing involve much more than just asking questions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term used to describe the group of people who receive the experimental stimulus."
Experimental condition is the term used to describe the group of people who receive the experimental stimulus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the idea that all items that make up a measuring instrument should be measuring the same thing and thus be consistent with one another."
Equivalence is the idea that all items that make up a measuring instrument should be measuring the same thing and thus be consistent with one another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to using primarily intuition and judgment to portray or evaluate the phenomena."
Reflective analysis refers to using primarily intuition and judgment to portray or evaluate the phenomena.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the presumed effect which varies concomitantly with changes or variations in the independent variable (X)."
The dependent variables (Y) are the presumed effect which varies concomitantly with changes or variations in the independent variable (X).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a symbol to which we can assign numerical values."
A variable is a symbol to which we can assign numerical values.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the "elements of theories discussed earlier, they are the building blocks that are interrelated in propositions that form the explanatory statements of a theory."
Concepts are the "elements of theories discussed earlier, they are the building blocks that are interrelated in propositions that form the explanatory statements of a theory.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a person's construction of the meaning of a phenomenon as opposed to the phenomenon as it exists external to the person."
Phenomenology refers to a person's construction of the meaning of a phenomenon as opposed to the phenomenon as it exists external to the person.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to searching the data for patterns, inherent in discourse, text, events or other phenomena with little or no inference made as to the meaning of the patterns."
Structural analysis refers to searching the data for patterns, inherent in discourse, text, events or other phenomena with little or no inference made as to the meaning of the patterns.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term invented to account for internal and directly unobservable psychological processes that in turn account for behaviour."
Intervening variable is a term invented to account for internal and directly unobservable psychological processes that in turn account for behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to compare the four Post-test scores and analysis of covariance to compare the gains."
Analysis of variance is used to compare the four Post-test scores and analysis of covariance to compare the gains.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a discussion of previous publications that bear directly on the topic you are investigating."
The review of literature is a discussion of previous publications that bear directly on the topic you are investigating.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those questions that provide respondents with a fixed set of alternatives from which they are to choose."
Close-ended questions are those questions that provide respondents with a fixed set of alternatives from which they are to choose.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act of looking out for and recording the presence or absence of verbal and non-verbal behavior of a person or group of persons."
Observation is the act of looking out for and recording the presence or absence of verbal and non-verbal behavior of a person or group of persons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a small proportion of a population selected for observation and analysis."
A sample is a small proportion of a population selected for observation and analysis.
fib: ______ is a method in which the researcher is a part of, and participates in the activities of the class, group, people or situation that is being studied.
Participant observation
Participant observation is a method in which the researcher is a part of, and participates in the activities of the class, group, people or situation that is being studied.
______ is a measure of internal consistency.
correlation coefficient calculated
The correlation coefficient calculated is a measure of internal consistency.
______ is a tentative answer to a question.
Research hypothesis
Research hypothesis is a tentative answer to a question.
______ is an estimate of the extent to which the values of the sample differs from those of the population from which it is drawn.
calculated sampling error
The calculated sampling error is an estimate of the extent to which the values of the sample differs from those of the population from which it is drawn.
______ is an abstract name for the meaning of similar topics.
category
A category is an abstract name for the meaning of similar topics.
______ is composed of three major types of coding: Open coding, axial coding and selective coding.
Analysis in grounded theory
Analysis in grounded theory is composed of three major types of coding: Open coding, axial coding and selective coding.
______ is a method in which the researcher is a part, and participates in the activities of the people, group or situation that is being studied.
Participant observer
Participant observer is a method in which the researcher is a part, and participates in the activities of the people, group or situation that is being studied.
______ is a more effective method of conducting a survey.
interview
The interview is a more effective method of conducting a survey.
______ means that, with all other characteristics equal, a simpler design is preferred to a more complex one.
criterion of parsimony
Parsimony - The criterion of parsimony means that, with all other characteristics equal, a simpler design is preferred to a more complex one.
______ are those uncontrolled by removing the variable matching, group matching and analysis of variance.
Extraneous variables
Extraneous variables are those uncontrolled by removing the variable matching, group matching and analysis of variance.
______ are the boundaries of the study.
Delimitations on the other hand
Delimitations on the other hand are the boundaries of the study.
______ is an independent variable directly manipulated by the experimenter in order to assess its effect on behaviour.
experimental treatment
The experimental stimulus or experimental treatment is an independent variable directly manipulated by the experimenter in order to assess its effect on behaviour.
______ is a group of subjects who are exposed to the experimental stimulus.
experimental group
An experimental group is a group of subjects who are exposed to the experimental stimulus.

______ refers to the process of selecting the core category systematically relating it to other categories, validating those relationships and filing in categories that need further refinement and development.
Selective coding

Selective coding refers to the process of selecting the core category systematically relating it to other categories, validating those relationships and filing in categories that need further refinement and development.
______ are used to gather information regarding an individual's experience and knowledge, his or her opinions, beliefs and feelings and demographics data.
Interviews
Interviews are used to gather information regarding an individual's experience and knowledge, his or her opinions, beliefs and feelings and demographics data.
______ are the specific objects or elements whose characteristics are to be described and explained and about which data will be collected.
Units of analysis
Units of analysis are the specific objects or elements whose characteristics are to be described and explained and about which data will be collected.
______ are the participant observer and the non-participant observer.
Two methods of observation
Two methods of observation are the participant observer and the non-participant observer.
______ is a constant threat to objective data-gathering and analysis.
Subjective bias
Subjective bias is a constant threat to objective data-gathering and analysis.
______ are a good ways of collecting certain information quickly and cheaply.
Questionnaires
Questionnaires are a good ways of collecting certain information quickly and cheaply.
______ means to generalise the experimental results to some individuals, conditions, methods and so forth.
Representativeness usually
Representativeness - Representativeness usually means to generalise the experimental results to some individuals, conditions, methods and so forth.
______ are those conditions beyond the control of the researcher that may place restrictions on the conclusion of the study and their applications to other situations.
Limitations
Limitations are those conditions beyond the control of the researcher that may place restrictions on the conclusion of the study and their applications to other situations.
______ refers to examining the data for constructs, themes and patterns that can be used to describe and explain the phenomenon studied.
Interpretational analysis
Interpretational analysis refers to examining the data for constructs, themes and patterns that can be used to describe and explain the phenomenon studied.
______ are the boundaries of the study.
Delimitations
Delimitations are the boundaries of the study.
______ is a study in itself and involves carbon dating, handwriting analysis, identification of ink and paper, vocabulary usage and writing style among others.
Establishing the genuineness of documents
Establishing the genuineness of documents is a study in itself and involves carbon dating, handwriting analysis, identification of ink and paper, vocabulary usage and writing style among others.
______ refers to the validity of the decision that there exist a statistically significant difference between the experimental group and the control group.
Statistical conclusion validity
Statistical conclusion validity refers to the validity of the decision that there exist a statistically significant difference between the experimental group and the control group.
______ is a data collection technique in which information is gathered from individuals called respondents by having them respond to questions.
survey
A survey is a data collection technique in which information is gathered from individuals called respondents by having them respond to questions.
______ are those factors that the researcher manipulates and to which he or she assigns subjects.
Treatment variables
Treatment variables are those factors that the researcher manipulates and to which he or she assigns subjects.
______ is a systematic process of describing, analysing and interpreting the past based on information from selected sources as they relate to the topic under study.
Historical research
Historical research is a systematic process of describing, analysing and interpreting the past based on information from selected sources as they relate to the topic under study.
______ is concerned with the degree to which the construct itself is actually measured.
Construct validity
Construct validity is concerned with the degree to which the construct itself is actually measured.
______ is the idea that a reliable measure should not change from one application to the next, assuming the concept being measured has not changed.
Stability
Stability is the idea that a reliable measure should not change from one application to the next, assuming the concept being measured has not changed.
______ is the extent to which a test result measures what it has been designed to measure.
Validity
Validity is the extent to which a test result measures what it has been designed to measure.
______ is the consistency with which a test result measures what it has been designed to measure (Oloyede, 2007).
Reliability
Reliability is the consistency with which a test result measures what it has been designed to measure (Oloyede, 2007).
______ is the main issue in any form of research.
interpretation of information
The interpretation of information is the main issue in any form of research.
______ are the measured changes in pupils' performance attributable to the influence of the independent variable.
dependent variables
The dependent variables are the measured changes in pupils' performance attributable to the influence of the independent variable.
______ refers to a set of procedures whereby data are put back together in new ways after open coding by making connections between categories.
Axial coding
Axial coding refers to a set of procedures whereby data are put back together in new ways after open coding by making connections between categories.
______ is an original or first-hand account of the event or experience.
primary source
A primary source is an original or first-hand account of the event or experience.
